item.title: Functional Programming in Rust 1: Closures
item.description: It is a Programming Paradigm where you use functions to solve what you are building. The most common features that you might have used FP in any language will be Map and Reduce. Where you pass in a function what iterates in the collection you run map or reduce on.

item.title: Understanding Rust Ownership
item.description: Ownership is one of the features that make it different than so many programming languages and what makes it memory safe and a good language for concurrent programming. It solves problems like null pointers, dangling pointers and data races.
